title: Three Nights and One Short Plumb
subtitle: 物理科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 物理科学（人与自然·科学与技术·物理与宇宙）
meta: 主题语境：物理科学（人与自然·科学与技术·物理与宇宙）　|　核心词汇：gravity　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gravity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the surveyor ① measured the gravity that no assistant on the ridge would have described, and he said the measuring was the whole of the night. The ② gravity, meaning the pull itself and not the weight, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; gravity, he said, is the only thing on a ridge that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of gravity on that ridge had the same short plumb beside it, and the ④ gravity at the far crag, meaning the reading they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Gravity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the surveyor said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gravity was the whole of the matter, meaning the seriousness and not the pull. The ⑥ gravity, meaning the seriousness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gravity, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a pull and a seriousness. He said the seriousness is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ gravity had become a line in a table, and the table had become an argument about the short plumb. The ⑧ gravity of the whole thing, the surveyor wrote in November, was one ridge and three nights of describing; gravity, he said, is either the reading at the far crag or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gravity I remember is the gravity described in the table, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest on the ridge. ⑩ Gravity, my mother said in 1981, is the only pull that improves by being described; all gravity, she said, is a seriousness that has agreed to look like a pull. She said the seriousness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 引力；重力（指山脊上每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 引力；重力（指那股拉力本身，与重量相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the gravity 测量重力
D. n. 重力读数（指留给孩子们学着读的那一个）
E. n. 重力（抽象总称，指一道山脊的重力之事）
F. n. 重力（指表格里写到、被记录过的那些）
G. n. 严重性；庄重（the gravity of the matter，指一件事里人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 严重（抽象总称，指人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: measured the gravity that no assistant on the ridge would have described
The gravity, meaning the pull itself and not the weight

the gravity at the far crag

answers.why: measure the gravity 意为“测量重力”，1972 年那位测量员测量了山脊上没有一位助手肯描述的重力。
gravity 意为“引力、重力”，指那股拉力本身而不是重量，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
gravity 意为“引力、重力”，指山脊上每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个矮矮的铅锤。
gravity 意为“重力读数”，指最远那处岩崖留给孩子们学着读的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gravity 意为“严重性、庄重”，指一件事里人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份严重就是那件事的全部。
gravity 意为“严重”，指人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那股引力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gravity 意为“重力”，指表格里写到、被记录过的那些，到 1977 年这些成了表格里的一行。
gravity 意为“重力”，测量员十一月写道，整件事的重力之事是一道山脊和三个夜晚的描述。
gravity 意为“重力”，我记得的是表格里描述过的那些，1979 年测完了，至今仍被说成山脊上最安静的一批。
gravity 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，重力是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的力量。
